description: This file defines the 'account_move_line' class extending osv.osv, with methods for calculating amount to pay, searching for payables, and associating bank accounts with move lines in an accounting module.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Model extending account.move.line with additional payment-related methods and fields.

methods.name: amount_to_pay
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount to pay for each move line, considering payment orders and cancellations.

methods.name: _to_pay_search
methods.description: Search method to find move lines that are payable, based on payment order status and account type.

methods.name: line2bank
methods.description: Associates each move line with a suitable bank account based on partner and invoice information.
